## Client

### Fixed

- The Console tab sends a command on the first Enter or Send. A command typed in full used to open the suggestion list, so the first Enter or click only closed it and nothing was sent. Enter runs the command, Tab completes one, and a server that never answers is reported after 15 seconds.

## Server

No change; the package is rebuilt so both halves carry the same version.
